games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: What does 'ambition' mean?
choices: A strong desire to achieve something important in life.
An important event or stage in the development of something.
Continuing to work hard even when things are difficult or take a long time.
Something that has been accomplished through effort and skill.
rounds.answer: A strong desire to achieve something important in life.
rounds.explanation: Her ambition is to become a doctor who helps children in rural areas.

rounds.prompt: What does 'dedication' mean?
choices: An important event or stage in the development of something.
Being fully committed to a task or purpose; giving time and energy to something.
Excellence that makes someone stand out; a high mark or honour.
Something that has been accomplished through effort and skill.
rounds.answer: Being fully committed to a task or purpose; giving time and energy to something.
rounds.explanation: His dedication to studying every evening helped him pass all his exams.

rounds.prompt: What does 'perseverance' mean?
choices: An important event or stage in the development of something.

The ability to recover from difficulties and keep going.
rounds.answer: Continuing to work hard even when things are difficult or take a long time.
rounds.explanation: Through perseverance, she learned to speak English fluently.

rounds.prompt: What does 'achievement' mean?
choices: A job that requires special training or education.
Excellence that makes someone stand out; a high mark or honour.
Something that has been accomplished through effort and skill.
The ability to recover from difficulties and keep going.
rounds.answer: Something that has been accomplished through effort and skill.
rounds.explanation: Winning the science prize was her greatest achievement this year.
